newsitem.title: UK: West Merchant profits up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: West Merchant profits up in 1996.

text.p: West Merchant Bank, the London-based investment banking arm of Germany's WestLB Group, said on Monday its 1996 pre-tax profit rose to 56.6 million stg from 36.2 million stg in the previous year.
West Merchant, which includes the stockbroker Panmure Gordon, said it made a pre-tax return on average capital of 31 percent, down from 36 percent in 1995.

The investment bank said the rise in profits was led by an expansion of its forfaiting business, higher prices in the emerging market debt business and further strides in developing its advisory business.
At Panmure Gordon, it said the broker's corporate division earned record fees with the firm raising its share of London market turnover.
